holder-quote: “Show-master. The Fury of Skies sounds like one. A [Cult Leader]? Orjin, you don’t think—?”
His power was far, far greater than anyone had led them to believe.
The Fury of Skies would not leave. The [Cult Leader] and [Martial Artist] of Windcaller’s Wrath, who used his showy wind-based martial arts, had mostly healed from his defeat by the Prophet.
The Fury of Skies beamed with self-satisfaction—then frowned at Orjin.
